channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Writers, US, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Writers, US, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: 2 new Writers residencies - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Surel's Place: Month-Long Artist Residency (September 2026 deadline)
    https://surelsplace.org/month-long-residencies/
    Surel's Place · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Free rent, utilities and wi-fi, a living stipend of USD 100 per week, a USD 300 travel stipend, use of well-maintained bicycles, free or discounted tickets to art events and movies, marketing through Surel's Place channels, and event hosting including logistics and installation help. Each resident also gets a local host to orient them and host their public events. No application fee. NOTE: Surel's Place takes a commission on sales arising from the residency, 35% of retail price on artwork, 45% on ticketed events that are offsite or need contracted services (calculated after administrative expenses), and 15% on books, CDs or other merchandise tangential to the artist's medium. A surcharge may apply to cover additional utility costs if a partner joins.
  • American Academy in Berlin: Berlin Prize Fellowship 2027-28
    https://www.americanacademy.de/apply/apply-for-a-fellowship/
    American Academy in Berlin · deadline 25 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of USD 5,000, plus roundtrip airfare, accommodation at or near the Hans Arnhold Center, partial board, in-house library services and professional networking opportunities. Roughly two dozen fellowships awarded each year. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).
